author: falz
body:
Age: 17

Timezone: UTC -3

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes

Do you have Discord? Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? No, but I can download one if needed.



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? No.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? I am a bit sensitive, so I think it'll affect the way I relate to the players while moderating. But I am working on it.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? A good leader should be able to handle a group's moral properly. Also being a good speaker and have good communication with the group. I would not consider me a leader. Because I am not exactly a good speaker, however I am really good at keeping people's moral high.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? I think I can be mature when it's needed. And also I try to get all the points of view before doing something.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? A good communication, be aware of what's going on in the community, also interacting with the community in many ways as posible is essential. I do think I have these skills.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? A good judgment, be mature when it's needed and not be toxic.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? I would talk to a senior staff member about this, and let him make a decision.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? I would tell them to be more respectful, although is in a channel where is allowed there's no need to be disrespectful towards other people.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would talk to a moderator or a senior and ask him if it's relevant or not.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? I would talk try to calm the other players, since the seniors aren't doing any harm to anyone.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? I really like avicus and I just want to make it a better place, and I think I can.


What does Avicus mean to you? A really good place to meet and play with others. And a nice community.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? Improve communication between community and staff members.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? As I said before, I really like this server and community overall,


Do you have anything else to add to your application? No.
